description: RiverWare supports reservoir and river-system simulation, rule-based operations, water accounting and optimisation. CADSWES publishes current releases, user guides, tutorials and training for the maintained software. The provider is CADSWES University of Colorado. Coverage: Applications represent user-defined river basins. Time scales, resolution and engineering algorithms depend on the configured model, not a shared source dataset. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The current licensing page lists paid standard and academic licences with separate maintenance fees. Academic rates exclude consulting. Limitations: No software was installed. Model assumptions, required solver licences and validity for a particular basin require separate checks. For simulation it supports reservoir operations and water-allocation planning. Related resources: model-usbr-crss-crmms-colorado-river describes two RiverWare applications, not the reusable software itself.
